purpose: One new targeted semantic/edition adjudication of seven known source-original ambiguous Grade II items, not repeating previous 110 source-research stage. Real new evidence in source original manual and I7 Annex 5.32 and adverse norm findings.

items.original_question: Dacă protecţia motoarelor contra suprasarcinilor este realizată cu întrerupere, dispozitivul de comutaţie trebuie să întrerupă obligatoriu:
article_locators: I7 §5.3.1.7.2.1, three consecutive clauses on active conductors, phase and optional neutral interruption
items.context_before_editorial: Overload protection normally covers active conductors, explicitly exempting the neutral from mandatory overload detection.
items.decisive_source_point_editorial: The source commands disconnection of all active conductors when interruption is used but immediately states neutral interruption is not mandatory.
items.context_after_editorial: Three-phase overload protection monitors all three phase conductors; object of the exam option 'all active' includes neutral in other definitions.

original_options_analysis.A: Literal copy of broad all-active disconnection wording, but seemingly clashes with immediately following N exception.
original_options_analysis.B: Neutral-only is insufficient for mandatory motor three-phase interruption.
original_options_analysis.C: Phase-only is consistent with neutral-exemption operational purpose but not the exact broad 'all active' wording.

items.source_limit: No unique source-scored letter without expert interpretation of whether 'active' in this clause is narrowed by the special N exception. Preserve two readings; source wording is potentially internally inconsistent.
items.next_specific_external_gate: Qualified technical+linguistic reviewer to annotate exact relation of the general instruction to its same-paragraph exception.

items.original_question: Pentru un circuit trifazat cu patru conductoare de aluminiu cu secţiunea conductoarelor de fază de 35 mm2,  conductorul neutru  are secţiunea minimă de:
article_locators: I7 Annex 5.32, Table row neutral N, Al phase 35 mm²
items.context_before_editorial: For phase Al up to 25 mm², neutral generally equals phase; at higher phase sections a reduction is potentially allowed only under the applicable phase-balance/harmonics and neutral overcurrent criteria.
items.decisive_source_point_editorial: Annex5.32 lists aluminium phase 35 mm² with minimum aluminium neutral 25 mm² when 3rd harmonics and multiples remain below 15%; reduced-neutral conditions must also hold.
items.context_after_editorial: When neutral unbalance or triplen harmonics occur, the design may require neutral 35 mm² or even larger; Annex5.29 and the protection scheme must be checked.

original_options_analysis.A: 16 mm² Al is not the table minimum for Al phase 35 mm², so cannot be accepted as the Annex5.32 answer.
original_options_analysis.B: 25 mm² Al is the lowest permissible listed neutral under the table's explicitly favorable load/harmonic assumptions, hence B is a source-backed minimum-POSSIBLE candidate.
original_options_analysis.C: 35 mm² Al may be needed for unbalanced or harmonic-rich circuit; it is not the lowest permitted section across permissible configurations.

items.source_limit: Original question omits balancing/harmonics/protection regime. B is a source-conditional lower bound, NOT unconditional safe sizing for every 35mm² circuit. Do not promote to ANRE graded key without official scoring evidence.
items.next_specific_external_gate: For didactic teaching display a balanced low-triplen and an unbalanced/high-triplen counterexample; obtain independent specialist + edition and original score key before release.

items.original_question: În vederea înscrierii la examenul de autorizare, electricianul trebuie să prezinte  în documentaţia anexată cererii de autorizare ,,Detalii privind lucrările realizate"; acest document este:

original_ABC.A: Opţional (solicitantul decide dacă îl transmite sau nu)
original_ABC.C: Un document obligatoriu, care trebuie întocmit corelat cu documenteie ,,Experienţă profesională" și ,,Pagina de informaţii anexate cererii de autorizare"

article_locators: ANRE Ordin 11/2013 Annex1 C, D as amended Ord116/2016
Government eDirect archived old authorization procedure document table
ANRE Ord99/2021 Art2 effective 2022-01-01 repeals Ord11/2013
items.context_before_editorial: In archived official ANRE Annex1, professional experience is recorded on form B and documentary evidence is supplemented by document C; the checklist verifies dossier completeness.
items.decisive_source_point_editorial: Archived Annex1 document C is named Detalii privind lucrările realizate and the dossier instructions require the applicant to complete and sign it.
items.context_after_editorial: Old official eDirect procedure specifically lists form C as part of the authorization application; it still references Ord11/2013 and is a stale procedure, not a present-day requirement.

original_options_analysis.A: Not optional under historical Ord11/2013 Annex1 mandatory documents, contrary to the A qualifier.
original_options_analysis.B: Not irrelevant in the historical annex; it records work and backs up professional experience.
original_options_analysis.C: Direct historical original-document support. The 2023 Excel wording matches the former Annex1 form and checklist.

items.source_limit: Source is OBSOLETE for May 2023 too: Ord11/2013 was superseded effective 2022-01-01 by Ord99/2021; Ord66/2023 applies from 2023-05-16. Must NOT use this archived C as 2026 exam scored answer.
items.next_specific_external_gate: Check whether exact form survived in Ord99/2021 or official historic ANRE scored key; if not, preserve as stale/teaching historical item only.

items.original_question: Actualizarea avizului tehnic de racordare atunci când se produce schimbarea titularului locului de producere sau de consum

original_ABC.A: este obligatorie numai dacă se modifică puterea aprobată anterior prin avizul tehnic de racordare;

items.context_before_editorial: Source §6(3) treats holder replacement as an administrative modification if power and technical installation unchanged.
items.decisive_source_point_editorial: The norm expressly exempts the connection certificate of an ALREADY CONNECTED site from updating on a holder-only change; this does not say a still active ATR is exempt.
items.context_after_editorial: ATR is the offer at an earlier connection process phase and is valid only until a connection certificate; original does not state precise site stage.

original_options_analysis.A: Holder change has regulatory significance even absent power change; A only-if-power rule too restrictive.
original_options_analysis.B: Can be true for an already connected CERTIFICATE, but the original explicitly asks ATR. Not a blanket ATR rule.
original_options_analysis.C: Plausible for active ATR change-of-holder case, but cannot certify universal obligation for all post-connection site conditions from original missing regime.

items.source_limit: Original stem asks ATR not certificate; C is source-favored in active-ATR regime only, but no official scored key or binding explicit unconditional mandate established.
items.next_specific_external_gate: Independent legal reviewer must pin holder-change request obligation at the original 2023 edition and site stage, then confirm grade-specific ANRE key.

items.original_question: Avizul tehnic de racordare este un aviz scris valabil:

original_ABC.A: pentru orice  titular al locului de producere/consum respectiv
original_ABC.B: numai pentru un anumit titular al locului de producere/consum
original_ABC.C: pe o perioadă de timp nelimitată

article_locators: Ord59/2013 Annex1 definition of 'aviz tehnic de racordare'
items.context_before_editorial: Normative term is defined as an offer/notice issued by network operator at request for a specific site and technical/economic conditions.
items.decisive_source_point_editorial: The Annex1 actual exclusive qualifier is a specific AMPLASAMENT, not a uniquely specified TITULAR.
items.context_after_editorial: Holder may change under administrative update; ATR does not last indefinitely, and post-connection certificate has separate status.

original_options_analysis.A: 'Any holder' ignores request-identity and administrative changes; does not reproduce the legal term.
original_options_analysis.B: 'Only a certain holder' is not the literal exclusive statutory qualifier; Annex1 names the site, not the holder. B may reflect historic intended key, but lacks exact-current-source equivalence.

items.source_limit: Exact legal object mismatch, stronger negative evidence than last run. Do not silently replace 'amplasament' by 'titular' or set B officially.
items.next_specific_external_gate: Seek ANRE original graded key/version or independent legal/linguistic adjudication. Preserve literal source-contradiction card.

items.original_question: Dacă se solicită avizul tehnic de racordare pentru o organizare de de şantier, documentaţia anexată cererii va cuprinde în mod obligatoriu şi:

original_ABC.A: certificatul de urbanism al obiectivului pentru care se organizează şantierul, în termen de valabilitate, in copie;
original_ABC.B: autorizaţia de construire a obiectivului pentru care se organizează şantierul, în termen de valabilitate, in copie;
original_ABC.C: contractul încheiat cu un furnizor de energie electrică

items.context_before_editorial: For a new/altered construction, the urbanism certificate belongs to initial application documentation.
items.decisive_source_point_editorial: The same article separately requires a construction permit when applying for temporary electricity supply of a construction organization.
items.context_after_editorial: Retail supply contract is not listed as compulsory for the initial network connection request.

original_options_analysis.A: May be mandatory for new or changed construction under §14(1)(c).
original_options_analysis.B: Explicitly mandatory for construction-site organization under §14(1)(h).
original_options_analysis.C: Supplier contract is not mandatory application attachment in §14(1).

items.source_limit: The question specifies site organization but not whether a new/modified structure is involved. In common new-building case A+B can both be required. No safe single answer without the intended examination qualification.
items.next_specific_external_gate: Get original source edition and verified scored key; alternatively classify as genuine multiple-correct source stem and teach condition on both.

items.original_question: Este obligatorie protecţia la suprasarcini pentru:

original_ABC.A: instalaţii din încăperi din categoriile celor cu risc de incendiu sau de explozie

article_locators: I7/2011 §4.3.2.4 and fire-safety protective design exceptions
items.context_before_editorial: Old I7/2002 §4.2.9 lists overload protection as compulsory for specific fire/explosion risk room categories.
items.decisive_source_point_editorial: Original option A aligns to old I7/2002 categories whereas old §4.2.9 also separately mentions control and signaling as exceptions.
items.context_after_editorial: I7/2011 later replaced the 2002 norm; exact 2002 rule cannot certify 2026 exam scope without an applicable 2011/2023 equivalent.

original_options_analysis.A: Historical intended choice is likely A for specifically classified risk environments; modern norm applicability is NOT proven.
original_options_analysis.B: Old norm includes control installation among contextual overload protection omissions.
original_options_analysis.C: Old norm includes signaling installation among contextual overload protection omissions.

items.source_limit: Source-year mismatch is confirmed. A remains historical teaching hint, not a 2026 ANRE scored answer.
items.next_specific_external_gate: Review 2026 grade bibliography for exact updated normative fire-risk provision and original key, do not rewrite question or score automatically.

hard_boundary: SEMANTIC_EQUIVALENCE closed means exact source-to-original 2013/2016 historical wording for LEG-R0024, or minimum permissible under balanced low-harmonics source text for NOR-R0084. It does NOT mean 2023/2026 grade source edition approved, answer letter official, original unqualified electrical sizing safe, or independence of reviewer.
source_verification_limits: ANRE 2016 official archived PDF parsed and ANRE e-government HTML independently corroborated. Web PDF visual screenshot retrieval failed, so not visually authenticated.
2026 ANRE bibliography and official scored answer key not established.
I7 Annex5.32 online text is public reproduction, reviewed with adjacent §5.2.4.6.1-3, not a digitally signed ANRE grade-specific edition.
Secondary question bank internet reproductions are NOT used as official score authentication.
